title: Beans and Apricots
beans: black & red (50/50), or beluga lentils & red beans (50/50)

items: 30 g fresh ginger, peeled and finely grated
2 green chiles, finely chopped, seeds and all (20 g)
1 lb beans (2 cups dry), soaked and rinsed
3 oz tomato paste (half a small can)
80 g soft-dried apricots, roughly chopped, soaked in hot water 20 min, drained
4 Tbsp (15 g) fresh cilantro, roughly chopped
3 limes: zest finely grated (1½ Tbsp), juiced (2 Tbsp)
